after_record.en: a calm low-expression baseline that remains stable while one small sign of warmth and a quiet supportive act become visible toward the same trusted counterpart as one possible realization of selective warmth beneath composure
after_record.ko: 침착하고 감정 표현이 적은 태도를 유지하면서도 같은 신뢰 상대에게 작은 온기와 조용한 돌봄 행동이 드러나는 쿨데레의 한 연출 예
after_record.ja: 冷静で感情表現の少ない態度を保ちながら、同じ信頼相手への小さな温かさと静かな支援行動が見えるクーデレの一つの表現例
after_record.definition: In one supported realization, a calm, emotionally restrained baseline remains intact around a specific trusted counterpart while positive affiliation becomes observable through one localized softening and one understated, target-directed supportive act with an already-visible consequence for that same counterpart. Stable composure plus selective relational warmth defines the general concept; the supportive act and its consequence are the selected cue scheme rather than universal lexical requirements. Expressionlessness, competence, attractiveness, hair, eyes, costume, role, palette, gaze, pose, or a caring prop alone does not establish the concept.
paraphrases: 늘 담담한 인물이 같은 동료의 젖은 소매를 조용히 정리해 주고 그 동료가 편해진 것을 확인하는 순간에 입매만 아주 조금 풀린다
차분한 태도는 그대로지만 신뢰하는 한 사람을 위한 실용적인 도움과 국소적인 온기가 같은 장면에서 드러난다
모두에게 감정 표현이 적은 성인이 특정 상대에게 필요한 물건을 먼저 건네고 그 상대가 안도하는 동안 눈가만 부드러워진다
Her composed low-expression baseline stays intact while she quietly solves one practical problem for the same trusted counterpart and only one facial area softens.
A restrained adult character shows selective warmth through a small same-target act whose helpful result is already visible, without hostility or a personality switch.
冷静な低反応のまま、同じ信頼相手を静かに助け、その相手の安心が見える瞬間だけ口元がわずかに和らぐ
平静さを崩さず、特定の相手にだけ小さな気遣いと局所的な温かさが現れる

confounders.ko: 조용한 돌봄이 아니라 감시 통제 강요나 경계 침범으로 드러나는 얀데레식 소유
